fact: The World Bank diagnostic says South Sudan's Civil Registry Act (2018), with the Nationality Act (2011), is the legal foundation of its identification system, and that the Civil Registration and National Identity Regulations (2024), drafted under the Act's sections 33 and 39, build on it; it calls the framework under-implemented, not absent.

The World Bank diagnostic says the Civil Registry Act (2018) and the 2024 Regulations under it lay the foundation for an interoperable digital ID ecosystem based on a Personal Identification Number tied to biometrically deduplicated IDs, with national identity cards, and a civil registry as national data source; implementation is extremely limited.
